lines.text: Can I get two small apple pies to take away, please?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: We only have one apple pie left. We also have small lemon cakes for four dollars each.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Is the lemon cake very sweet? One of us likes things that are less sweet.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: It is less sweet than the apple pie. Would you like one of each?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, please. How much is that in total? I have ten dollars in cash.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The pie is five dollars, so it is nine dollars for both.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Great. Can you put them in separate bags? The lemon cake is for my friend.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. One apple pie in this bag, and one lemon cake in the other bag.
lines.speaker: Eli
